description: Port coverage for Wan Hai (WHL) v2 port-to-port scrape. Keys are the 8 curated US ports from whl_connections.json['ports']; type is 'port' (queried origin->port in v2). Cities from whl_cities.json (shared read-only). WHL quirk: for some origins the pod dropdown lists inland destinations but NOT the port that serves them; scrape_with_decision/pick_pod handle this by falling back to an inland served via that port (relationship in whl_connections.json), so port coverage is preserved.
